gaps.sentence: They set ___ to climb the north face in April.
gaps.explanation: set out (to do) = begin a job/mission with a goal.

gaps.sentence: The new manager wants to back ___ the sales team's proposal.
gaps.explanation: back up = support (a person, plan); also make a copy of data.

gaps.sentence: Put ___ your toys when you've finished playing.
gaps.explanation: put away = put something in its usual place.

gaps.sentence: To sum ___, we need more time and a bigger budget.
gaps.explanation: sum up = summarize the main points.

gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
You should cut down ___ sugar if you want to lose weight.
gaps.explanation: cut down ON something = reduce it; cut out = eliminate completely.
